subject.title: fix(cron): honor explicit announce delivery on system-event jobs

question: Should an unpinned `systemEvent` with explicit channel delivery be implicitly retyped into an isolated `agentTurn`, or should callers continue to select the isolated agent-turn contract explicitly?
rationale: The proposed behavior is not a mechanical bug repair alone: it changes the user-visible meaning, tool-policy surface, and session behavior of an existing payload type.

options.title: Keep the explicit contract
options.body: Retain the creation-time rejection and improve the error or caller guidance so callers create an isolated `agentTurn` when they need channel delivery.

options.title: Adopt implicit conversion
options.body: Accept the conversion only with documented semantics, full payload-policy preservation, all supported target forms, upgrade coverage, and real delivery proof.

recommendation.title: Keep the explicit contract
recommendation.body: Retain the creation-time rejection and improve the error or caller guidance so callers create an isolated `agentTurn` when they need channel delivery.
